Home/Emergency/Severe Bleeding
Emergency situation?

Do not waste time reading if the animal is not breathing or unconscious. Call a vet immediately.

CRITICAL

Severe Bleeding

For heavy bleeding, apply sterile gauze or a clean cloth and maintain firm, direct pressure. If the dressing soaks through, do not remove it — add another layer on top and keep applying pressure; if a leg is bleeding, you can raise it above heart level on the way to the clinic.

See a vet TODAY (do not wait)
